response.description: We’re bringing Azure Monitor’s dynamic threshold capabilities to Log search alerts!Using dynamic thresholds means you don't have to know the right threshold for each Log alert rule - Dynamic thresholds calculate the most appropriate thresholds for you.Key benefitsDynamic thresholds apply advanced machine learning and use a set of algorithms and methods to:Learn the historical behavior of log query results.Analyze these results over time and identify hourly / daily / weekly seasonal patterns.Calculate the most appropriate thresholds for log alert rules.Adapt automatically to changes in data patterns and adjust the threshold accordingly.At-scale monitoring - in rule monitoring multiple dimensions - the Dynamic threshold is calculated individually, per dimension combination.Learn more.
response.title: Public Preview: Dynamic threshold for Log search alerts
